findings.description: CON-SUP-125 lists the state labels but does not define their transition rules. SYS-SUP-051 nevertheless selects STARTUP or OPERATIONAL between fault detection and safe-state entry, including during a start-up fault and after a code 8 report. Its rationale and blocking OP-SYS-015 identify these cases as undecided.
findings.requested_change: Resolve OP-SYS-015 with a product decision and align the state-selection conditions with that decision; until then, avoid prescribing the undecided outcomes.

findings.description: SAFE applies from completion of safe-state entry until reset, while LATCHED applies while the safe state is latched. After a latch-triggering fault under SYS-SUP-028 or SYS-SUP-043 and completion of safe-state entry, both conditions apply until reset, so the required state value is not uniquely determined.
findings.requested_change: Define mutually exclusive state conditions or an explicit precedence for SAFE and LATCHED, supported by the product decision on state transitions.
